LNG export marine terminal (2 x 225,000 m3, 2 berths, 28 MTPA)
Berth 2 arms on the platform, south to north: LA-5101 liquid, LA-5102 vapour, LA-5103 hybrid, LA-5104 liquid (S-01); drawn left to right L, L, H, V.
16 inch, ~4,000 m3/h per liquid arm; the hybrid runs as the third liquid arm and is the spare vapour path (D-014, D-023).
ESD-2 trips ESD-1 at once (C&E I-503 into I-501); the ERS valves (two ball valves either side of the emergency release coupler) close 5 s later by I-507, not on ESD-1;
ERS valves de-energise-to-trip on 2oo2 line-monitored solenoids, couplers energise-to-release after the ERS valves are closed (D-016).
Thermal relief (15.0 barg) to D-5101: PSV-5171 / 5173 / 5174 per liquid arm section, PSV-5118 on the drain pump discharge. Vapour arm connected first, disconnected last (S-01).
D-5101 sits at the platform low point (drawn above the header). Its vent BOG-5002 has no valve: it is the drum's relief path and stays open.
XV-5123 / XV-5125: open-command permissives, each opens only with the other proven closed (ZSC-5123 / ZSC-5125, C&E I-504 / I-505), never trip an open valve; key interlock at the arm (vendor).
Arm purge (D-026): before loading the N2 goes into the carrier's manifold (S-01); after loading the arms drain to D-5101 and the purge N2 leaves by the drum vent BOG-5002 into the vapour return.
HV-5119 normally closed (pump vent/drain). BOG-5003, DR-5002 to DR-5007, LNG-5005, LNG-5007, N-5001: see the line list. Arm vents, drains, O2 sample point: arm package.
Air failure: PZT-8123A/B/C (P-08, C&E I-804) trip ESD-1 first; XV-5101 and the arm isolations hold on accumulators, closing at their set speed; ERS valves hydraulic (HPU).
O2 above 5 vol %: C&E I-514 closes XV-5122 / XV-5125 with no liquid transfer, else ESD-1 (I-501); ZSO-5122 not open in a transfer: ESD-1 (D-030).
